facts.fact: HoA DRIVE Somalia says the Somali Bureau of Standards is building an integrated management information system that includes a Somali-English AI chatbot guiding users through certification, with rollout preparation still the next phase.

SOM.note: Links to Customs and the National Single Window are only planned for later; no customs system is described.
No technical standards for government systems to exchange data are named.

facts.fact: HoA DRIVE Somalia describes the Somali Bureau of Standards as overseeing quality and compliance services for goods in Somalia, with a searchable catalogue of national standards on its new platform.

SOM.note: No information technology or data standard and no certification against one is named.
